rationale: Enable all ten tools so each name binds from its own demonstrations across the full family. Concrete bindings include reverse for name 7 in task 1, minimum for name 2 and collapse consecutive duplicates for name 3 in task 2, and sum modulo 10 for name 4 and ascending sort for name 5 in task 3. Every entry is needed to support unrestricted tool bindings in unseen tasks.
